messages:
sarah_sales: Kicking off the OrbitFleet POC — they want a 4-week pilot. Need alignment on scope, acceptance tests, and pricing. @akash can you lead the integration plan?
akash_se: Yep. Quick Q: which endpoints are in-scope? Chat (assistant), document search (embeddings + rerank), or also realtime rerank on ticketing? Need expected QPS and sample payloads.
marco_solutions: From discovery: primary is in-app assistant + semantic search over their product docs, secondary is rerank for support tickets. My recommendation: focus on assistant + search for MVP. Proposed acceptance targets: p50 latency <350ms, p99 <900ms for chat; search precision@5 >= 0.85 on their eval set; overall error rate <1%. They also require EU data residency.
liz_pm: Success criteria (to share with client): - Chat: >=90% task completion on curated 50-prompt eval set (we'll run). - Search: precision@5 >=0.85 on their test corpus. - Stability: <1% error/timeout across 48h soak. - Security: must pass our customer security questionnaire items for KMS + SSO + audit logs. - Handoff: 1 runbook + SDK sample.
akash_se: I'll need their eval prompts and a sample of docs (PDFs). I'll prep the eval harness and a small prompt set (~50 prompts) for chat assessment. Also: what are target throughput numbers? (tokens/sec or qps)
sarah_sales: Client asked for ballpark pricing for ~10M tokens/month and 100k embeddings. They also asked if we can do a 3-week free pilot and a committed discount after. @liz_pm who owns the pricing sketch?
liz_pm: I'll draft pricing options today. Quick plan: hosted API with a 10% first-quarter discount on a 6-month commit, or Dedicated estimate if they want guaranteed throughput. I'll include an estimate for the token/embed mix. Need security signoff before sharing some numbers. Also request: please get them to sign the NDA before we ingest their docs.
sec-bot: Security questionnaire received from OrbitFleet. Key items flagged: KMS integration (customer-managed keys asked), data residency (EU-only), SSO (SAML), audit log retention (12 months), DPIA request. Questions: do they require on-prem or VPC? Do they need HSM-backed keys? Please upload their completed questionnaire spreadsheet to the shared folder.
marco_solutions: Integration runbook outline: - Auth: API key or mTLS (we can support SAML-backed provisioning). - Endpoints: /v1/generate (chat), /v1/embeddings, /v1/rerank. - Fallback policy: smaller model variant if p99 latency spikes. - Rate limits: configurable per customer; need their peak qps. Milestones: Week1 env + auth, Week2 ingest + embeddings, Week3 chat integration + eval runs, Week4 tuning + handoff + runbook.
akash_se: Eval harness snippet I'll use (curl example): ```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"rwd-chat-3b","input":"<prompt>","max_tokens":256}'``` I will also attach a small Python runner to compute task completion and precision@k.
sarah_sales: OrbitFleet also flagged encryption at rest + per-tenant logging exports. @sec-bot can you pull the checklist and confirm we meet EU export rules and KMS options?
sec-bot: Checklist created: https://redwood.internal/secure/checklists/ef3a. Outstanding items: customer-managed KMS flow doc, ISO27001 attestation copy, EU region pinning confirmation. ETA to gather docs: 48 hours.
liz_pm: I'll draft the success criteria doc and the pricing sheet, and send a single consolidated deck to OrbitFleet. Sarah — can you get their sample docs and NDA signed by tomorrow?
sarah_sales: Will do. I'll confirm the 4-week timeline with the customer and propose the milestones. Next sync: Thursday 9am PT — I'll send the invite. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
